assembly_instructions: 1. 3D scan the user's residual forearm and print the custom Nylon-12 socket at 0.26 m overall length with a 0.14 m outside elbow diameter, a 0.11 m distal diameter, and a longitudinal dorsal service cutaway left open in this scene.

2. Bond the soft black elbow rim to the proximal socket ring, then fasten the four white composite socket shell rails and the lower keel rail between the proximal and distal rings so the lowest rim just touches world y = 0.
3. Install the two inner rubber liner rails and place the port and starboard EMG electrode pads on opposite inner wall faces where they contact flexor and extensor muscle sites.

4. Fit the wrist bearing stack to the distal socket ring by adding the rear race, rotating wrist ring, detent pin, front race, and four visible adaptor bolts for the 180 degree manual rotation interface.
5. Assemble the palm as an open frame by joining the palmar plate, dorsal plate, and two side cheeks to the wrist adaptor so the five micro gearmotors remain inspectable.
6. Mount five brushed-steel micro gearmotors across the palm root and connect each motor to its own short copper branch lead from the five-channel harness bus.
7. Install the five short steel drive shafts between the motors and the proximal phalanx hinges for thumb, index, middle, ring, and pinky digits.
8. Build each digit from rounded capsule phalanges, inserting separate hinge pins at the MCP, PIP, and DIP or thumb IP joints, then add black rubber contact pads to the distal tips.
9. Route the flat motor harness from the palm motor bay through the wrist ring to the STM32 control board, and connect the two EMG leads to the board input edge.
10. Fit the Li-ion battery pack above the board in the exploded service stack, with vertical guide posts showing the drop-in direction from the cover opening to the real socket bay.

11. Assemble the removable hero cover as two side rails, two edge rails, and three cross ribs; in this exploded scene the cover is lifted 0.18 m above the socket so the board, battery, latch bosses, magnets, and removable cosmetic shell are simultaneously visible.

info.japanese_name: Open Bionics Hero Arm（筋電義手）
info.english_name: Open Bionics Hero Arm — Myoelectric Prosthetic Arm
info.summary: 3D-printed, direct-print, myoelectric below-elbow prosthesis from Open Bionics. EMG sensors on the residual limb translate muscle signals into six pre-programmed grips.
info.description: The Hero Arm is a 3D-printed myoelectric below-elbow prosthesis developed by Open Bionics (Bristol, UK). It replaces the hand and forearm of a transradial amputee with a custom-fit socket that is 3D-scanned from the residual limb, ensuring a personalized, comfortable fit. Two skin-contact EMG sensors on the inner wall of the socket pick up muscle signals from the remaining forearm; an embedded STM32-based control board classifies those signals in real time and drives five independent finger motors to execute one of several pre-programmed grip patterns (fist, tripod, pinch, hook, key-grip, point). A 180 degree rotation wrist ring lets the user pronate or supinate the hand for natural posing. The powered parts sit under a magnetically attached external cover that snaps off for battery swaps and comes in multiple colors and themed hero covers. The entire structural shell is printed in laser-sintered Nylon 12 for toughness, and Open Bionics publishes portions of the design to support clinical fitting and aftermarket customization.
info.operator: Fitted by partner clinics; used worldwide by transradial amputees including pediatric users
info.contract_value: approximately GBP 10k UK NHS reference pricing; varies by fit
info.status: In production, covered by the NHS in the UK and various insurers elsewhere

facts.label: Overall scene length
facts.value: 0.49 m from elbow rim to longest middle fingertip, representative of a pediatric or small adult transradial Hero Arm scale

facts.label: Socket envelope
facts.value: 0.26 m long custom SLS Nylon-12 socket with 0.14 m outside elbow diameter and 0.11 m distal diameter

facts.label: Control
facts.value: 2 skin-contact EMG sensors feed an STM32-class controller driving 5 independent finger motor channels

facts.label: Grip programs
facts.value: 6 programmed grip patterns: fist, tripod, pinch, hook, key-grip, and point

facts.label: Wrist rotation
facts.value: Manual wrist ring provides 180 degrees of pronation and supination indexing

facts.label: Palm motor bay
facts.value: 5 gearmotors are shown across a 0.085 m wide palm root with individual drive shafts and branch leads to the MCP hinges

facts.label: Digit construction
facts.value: 4 fingers use three capsule phalanges plus 3 visible hinge pins each; the thumb uses two capsule links plus 2 visible hinge pins

facts.label: Exploded service stack
facts.value: Control board is shown 0.155 m above the socket centerline, battery 0.195 m above, and cover rails 0.255 m above

facts.label: Cover retention
facts.value: 4 magnetic latch bosses locate the removable hero cover over the socket for battery access

facts.label: Mass target
facts.value: Commercial Hero Arm is marketed as lightweight, typically under about 1 kg depending on user size and cover

parts.name: Proximal Soft Socket Rim
parts.role: Soft black rim forms the open elbow-side contact edge and sets the root datum for the custom socket.

parts.name: Distal Socket Ring
parts.role: Printed distal ring closes the tapered socket shell and carries the wrist bearing stack.

parts.name: Socket Shell Upper Port Rail
parts.role: Longitudinal Nylon-12 shell rail leaves the dorsal service window open while preserving the socket outline.

parts.name: Socket Shell Upper Starboard Rail
parts.role: Opposite longitudinal shell rail frames the removable hero-cover opening and exposes the electronics bay.

parts.name: Socket Shell Lower Port Rail
parts.role: Lower port shell strip carries residual-limb load and makes the socket visibly hollow instead of a solid cylinder.

parts.name: Socket Shell Lower Starboard Rail
parts.role: Lower starboard shell strip completes the open socket cradle and keeps the second EMG pad visible.

parts.name: Socket Lower Keel Rail
parts.role: Thin underside rail ties the lower socket quadrants together and gives the assembly a clear ground-touching datum.

parts.name: Inner Comfort Liner Port Rail
parts.role: Soft inner liner rail spaces the residual limb from the printed shell and locates the port-side electrode.

parts.name: Inner Comfort Liner Starboard Rail
parts.role: Soft inner liner rail mirrors the port rail and keeps the starboard electrode in skin contact.

parts.name: Port EMG Electrode Pad
parts.role: Skin-contact surface EMG pad reads one residual forearm muscle group through the cutaway socket wall.

parts.name: Starboard EMG Electrode Pad
parts.role: Second EMG pad reads an opposing muscle site so the controller can distinguish open and close commands.

parts.name: Port EMG Lead
parts.role: Low-voltage signal lead routes the port electrode to the exposed controller input edge.

parts.name: Starboard EMG Lead
parts.role: Second signal lead routes the starboard electrode to the controller input pair.

parts.name: Wrist Rear Bearing Race
parts.role: Rear bearing race bolts to the distal socket ring and supports the rotating wrist interface.

parts.name: Manual 180 Degree Wrist Ring
parts.role: Manually indexed ring lets the user pronate or supinate the terminal hand through a half-turn.

parts.name: Wrist Front Bearing Race
parts.role: Front race transfers wrist rotation loads into the palm frame.

parts.name: Wrist Detent Pin
parts.role: Small pin marks the indexed stop mechanism that holds the wrist at selected rotation angles.

parts.name: Upper Wrist Adaptor Bolt
parts.role: Small visible fastener shows the rear race is bolted to the printed distal socket ring.

parts.name: Lower Wrist Adaptor Bolt
parts.role: Opposite fastener completes the socket-side wrist bearing attachment pattern.

parts.name: Port Palm Adaptor Bolt
parts.role: Small fastener shows the front race is mechanically tied into the palm frame.

parts.name: Starboard Palm Adaptor Bolt
parts.role: Matching palm-side fastener completes the visible wrist-to-hand assembly joint.

parts.name: Open Palm Palmar Plate
parts.role: Lower printed palm frame plate supports the motor bay while leaving the gearmotors visible above it.

parts.name: Open Palm Dorsal Plate
parts.role: Top palm plate is lifted above the motor bay so the drive layout is visible rather than hidden in a block.

parts.name: Palm Port Side Cheek
parts.role: Side cheek ties the palm plates together and forms the outer wall for the thumb-side motor bay.

parts.name: Palm Starboard Side Cheek
parts.role: Opposite palm cheek leaves the center open so the five root motors can be inspected.

parts.name: Back-of-Hand Small Cover Badge
parts.role: Small dorsal cosmetic badge shows the Hero Arm back-of-hand cover without hiding the motor bay.

parts.name: Thumb Micro Gearmotor
parts.role: Dedicated thumb motor drives the opposed thumb through its short shaft and MCP hinge.

parts.name: Index Micro Gearmotor
parts.role: Index motor independently flexes the index finger for point, pinch, and tripod grip programs.

parts.name: Middle Micro Gearmotor
parts.role: Middle motor gives the longest finger its own powered channel for full fist closure.

parts.name: Ring Micro Gearmotor
parts.role: Ring finger motor drives the fourth digit as an independent actuator rather than a cosmetic duplicate.

parts.name: Pinky Micro Gearmotor
parts.role: Pinky motor powers the shortest finger and preserves five-motor recognizability.

parts.name: Five-Channel Motor Harness Bus
parts.role: Flat copper-colored bus distributes five motor driver channels from the controller through the wrist into the palm.

parts.name: Thumb Motor Branch Lead
parts.role: Individual branch lead makes the thumb motor's separate controller channel visible.

parts.name: Index Motor Branch Lead
parts.role: Individual branch lead connects the harness bus to the index gearmotor.

parts.name: Middle Motor Branch Lead
parts.role: Individual branch lead connects the harness bus to the middle gearmotor.

parts.name: Ring Motor Branch Lead
parts.role: Individual branch lead connects the harness bus to the ring gearmotor.

parts.name: Pinky Motor Branch Lead
parts.role: Individual branch lead connects the harness bus to the pinky gearmotor.

parts.name: Thumb Drive Shaft
parts.role: Short shaft links the thumb motor output to the opposed thumb MCP hinge.

parts.name: Index Drive Shaft
parts.role: Index output shaft carries torque from the gearmotor to the MCP hinge.

parts.name: Middle Drive Shaft
parts.role: Middle shaft transmits motor torque to the longest finger's proximal joint.

parts.name: Ring Drive Shaft
parts.role: Ring shaft exposes the mechanical link between the fourth motor and fourth finger.

parts.name: Pinky Drive Shaft
parts.role: Pinky shaft connects the fifth motor to the shortest finger's MCP hinge.

parts.name: Thumb MCP Hinge Pin
parts.role: Visible hinge pin anchors the opposed thumb to the palm frame.

parts.name: Thumb Proximal Rounded Phalanx
parts.role: Rounded first thumb segment is angled across the palm to show the Hero Arm's opposed thumb posture.

parts.name: Thumb IP Hinge Pin
parts.role: Thumb interphalangeal hinge separates the proximal and distal thumb links.

parts.name: Thumb Distal Rounded Link
parts.role: Rounded thumb tip link closes against the index and middle fingers for pinch grips.

parts.name: Thumb Rubber Contact Pad
parts.role: Black contact pad marks the thumb surface that presses against objects in pinch and key grips.

parts.name: Index MCP Hinge Pin
parts.role: Index root hinge pin makes the powered knuckle visible at the palm edge.

parts.name: Index Proximal Rounded Phalanx
parts.role: Rounded index proximal segment projects from the palm and forms the first link of the pointing finger.

parts.name: Index PIP Hinge Pin
parts.role: Index middle knuckle hinge separates proximal and middle links.

parts.name: Index Middle Rounded Phalanx
parts.role: Rounded index middle segment gives the finger realistic three-link articulation.

parts.name: Index DIP Hinge Pin
parts.role: Index fingertip hinge marks the distal joint rather than merging the tip into one block.

parts.name: Index Distal Rounded Tip
parts.role: Rounded index fingertip is the contact link used for pointing and precision pinch.

parts.name: Index Rubber Fingertip Pad
parts.role: Soft black fingertip pad shows where the index finger contacts objects.

parts.name: Middle MCP Hinge Pin
parts.role: Middle root hinge locates the longest finger at the center of the palm.

parts.name: Middle Proximal Rounded Phalanx
parts.role: Longest rounded proximal phalanx establishes the middle finger's greater reach.

parts.name: Middle PIP Hinge Pin
parts.role: Middle finger central hinge separates the long proximal and middle phalanges.

parts.name: Middle Middle Rounded Phalanx
parts.role: Rounded middle segment continues the longest digit and helps the fist silhouette read correctly.

parts.name: Middle DIP Hinge Pin
parts.role: Middle distal hinge defines the final flexion joint before the fingertip.

parts.name: Middle Distal Rounded Tip
parts.role: Longest rounded fingertip reaches slightly farther than neighboring digits as on a human-like hand.

parts.name: Middle Rubber Fingertip Pad
parts.role: Soft black fingertip pad marks the middle finger's primary grasp contact.

parts.name: Ring MCP Hinge Pin
parts.role: Ring finger root hinge is a separate mechanical joint with its own motor channel.

parts.name: Ring Proximal Rounded Phalanx
parts.role: Rounded ring proximal phalanx mirrors the index length to complete the four-finger array.

parts.name: Ring PIP Hinge Pin
parts.role: Ring middle hinge shows the finger is articulated rather than a single printed prong.

parts.name: Ring Middle Rounded Phalanx
parts.role: Rounded ring middle segment flexes with the proximal segment for fist and hook grips.

parts.name: Ring DIP Hinge Pin
parts.role: Ring distal hinge makes the tip joint visible in plan and isometric views.

parts.name: Ring Distal Rounded Tip
parts.role: Rounded ring fingertip contributes to full-hand grasp contact.

parts.name: Ring Rubber Fingertip Pad
parts.role: Soft black fingertip pad marks the ring finger's grasp contact surface.

parts.name: Pinky MCP Hinge Pin
parts.role: Pinky root hinge sits slightly shorter and lower in the finger fan.

parts.name: Pinky Proximal Rounded Phalanx
parts.role: Shorter rounded pinky proximal segment gives the hand a recognizable tapered finger row.

parts.name: Pinky PIP Hinge Pin
parts.role: Pinky middle hinge separates the shorter fifth finger into functional links.

parts.name: Pinky Middle Rounded Phalanx
parts.role: Rounded pinky middle segment keeps the fifth digit articulated while visibly shorter than the ring finger.

parts.name: Pinky DIP Hinge Pin
parts.role: Pinky distal hinge gives the smallest finger a separate tip joint.

parts.name: Pinky Distal Rounded Tip
parts.role: Shortest rounded fingertip completes the four-finger cascade for grasping small objects.

parts.name: Pinky Rubber Fingertip Pad
parts.role: Soft black fingertip pad marks the pinky finger's smaller grasp contact.

parts.name: Hero Cover Rear Cross Rib
